name: dig
description: Spotify playlist tools: create, edit, reorder, dedupe, and grow playlists with verified tracks. Requires Spotify Premium. Dig — a Line 7 product.

spotify_client_id.title: Spotify Client ID
spotify_client_id.description: Your Spotify app's Client ID (32 letters and numbers, from developer.spotify.com/dashboard). Never paste your Client Secret.

dig_enable_unfollow.title: Enable playlist deletion
dig_enable_unfollow.description: Type true to enable the dig_unfollow_playlist tool. WARNING: for playlists you own, unfollowing IS deletion (Spotify keeps deleted playlists recoverable for 90 days at spotify.com). Leave blank to keep it off. After changing this, start a new chat.
